Hi Sean,

We're preparing final workpapers for Redwood's SOC 2 Type II and need clarification on how you treat partial-month evidence around the period end. Specifically:

- Audit period we have on file: 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31. Can you confirm whether that is correct and whether the month-end is inclusive through 2026-10-31 23:59:59 (which timezone?)

Also, auditors on our end sometimes request a single consolidated export versus multiple per-service exports — do you have a preferred format (CSV, JSON, compressed bundle)?

Appreciate a short response we can include in the workpapers. Thanks,

Hi Claire — thanks for the note. Looping in Monica (compliance lead) and Neha (infra) to confirm details; preliminary answers below and attached a sample export to illustrate our timestamps.

- Audit period: we confirm the Type II period is 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31, inclusive. The controls testing window is bounded at 2026-10-31 23:59:59 UTC unless otherwise negotiated.
- Timestamps: our canonical logs use UTC timestamps. We can provide exports normalized to UTC; the attached sample (redwood_syslog_20261031.csv) shows the format (ISO8601, UTC).
- Point-in-time snapshots: we can provide end-of-day (23:59:59 UTC) snapshots for the last day of the period for services that support snapshots.
- Evidence after period end: we can either (a) provide a short bridge letter signed by our VP Security & Compliance to attest no material changes to control environment, or (b) provide incremental evidence covering the gap (e.g., logs through the requested date). Monica, Neha — any preference on whether to provide a bridge letter vs incremental exports for this engagement?

On Mon, Nov 15, 2026 at 08:14 AM PST, Claire Hudson <claire.hudson@pondelaudit.com> wrote:
> We're preparing final workpapers ... Can you confirm whether the month-end is inclusive through 2026-10-31 23:59:59 (which timezone?)

Hi Claire — confirming the following as Redwood's standard for SOC 2 Type II deliveries:

1) Period definition: SOC 2 Type II attestation period is 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31 (inclusive).
2) Timezone: we normalize all audit evidence to UTC. End-of-day evidence is provided as 23:59:59 UTC for the period boundary unless you request local-time conversions.
3) Partial-month evidence: we accept consolidated exports that cover the full timestamp range. For services that do not support atomic snapshots, provide (a) export of events with UTC timestamps, and (b) the associated configuration snapshot and change logs that show no retroactive modification.
4) Bridge letter vs incremental evidence: Our preferred approach is to provide a short bridge letter for a narrow gap (up to 30 days) stating there were no control changes that would affect SOC scope, signed by VP, Security & Compliance. If the auditor requires verifiable activity after period end, we can instead supply additional logs for the intervening days. We can do both if helpful.

Attached is a draft bridge-letter we typically use; we can finalise and get it signed once you confirm the exact dates you want covered. Also, for file integrity we can provide MD5 checksums or SHA256 hash for any exported files.

Attachments:
- bridge-letter-draft.docx (draft bridge letter, DOCX)

Let me know which option you prefer and the final cutoff date for any additional incremental evidence you need.

Regards,

Monica Patel
